description:
Description: 
 This position develops, tests, executes and documents database SQL programs for use in supporting disease management applications utilizing both Oracle and MS SQL technologies. 
 Development of custom reports and working with App Support team on a data cleanup project. 

 MS Access and Crystal Reports experience is a must. 

 Delivery of documentation is required at the end of the contract period. 

 Responsibilities: 

 Develop Packages, Stored Procedures, Triggers, and other PL/SQL and T-SQL programs.
 Develop custom reports using Crystal Reports, Cognos, or Business Objects 

 Develop UNIX scripts to support batch processes or data conversion. 

 Optimize Queries, Stored Procedures, ETL process, and databases performance. 

 Gather and analyze business requirements for Data warehouse and Business Intelligence Projects. 

 Provide quality oversight for all activities related to data cleansing, data quality and data consolidation using standard data modeling methodologies and processes. 

 Write user documentation for database systems created and/or maintained by the department. 

 Requirements: 

 Minimum of seven (7) years' Oracle, MS SQL, Data warehouse design and development experience required
 Experience in designing and developing high volume transaction based systems required 

 Experience in SQL, SQL*Plus, SQL*Loader, Exp/Imp, Oracle scheduler, Advanced Queues, Object management, Informatica Power Center, PL/SQL development, stored procedures, and triggers required 

 Proficient in Toad, MS Access, Erwin, Visio, and Version Control tools required 

 Experience using bulk processing, DBMS packages required 

 Experience in analyzing query plans and query tuning, partitioning, and optimizer hints required 

 Experience in Data warehouse and Business Intelligence implementation required 

 Intermediate computer skills and proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook require 

 

 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION:4 - 6 MONTHS 
 
 INTERVIEW: PHONE & SKYPE
